description: Boot-smoke milestone baselines. Owner decision 22 (2026-09-18) replaced the self-tracking `190 + 2 x transport sectors` menu identity with two independent numbers: an absolute ceiling that states the owner's real budget, and a delta against the baseline below. The 2026-09-20 re-basing applies the same shape to the `loader` milestone, which until then was gated only by accident through a hard-coded frame-300 observation point in the boot smoke. Re-record `baseline` deliberately, in the same commit as the change that grows the transport on purpose, and state the reason in the commit message.

recorded.reason: Re-bound for owner decision X (2026-09-21), the level-buffer shrink and the HYBRID_C_WINDOW plumbing at $B600-$BBFF (plan-light-multiplicity.md step 0). The four milestones did NOT move: XEX 135/392 and ATR 319/576, identical to the 6fc2898 recording, MEASURED from a full 8-session boot smoke, 8/8 passed. They could not move, because the window record carries no content yet and the transport therefore stays at 195 sectors; only the artifact identity is re-recorded. Below $A000 the step is deliberately NOT byte-identical, and the difference is fully accounted for: the tenth DFMC manifest slot (MAX_CHUNKS / CHUNK_MAX_COUNT 9 -> 10) grows the stage-2 reservation by 16 B, which moves five address operands in the boot copier at $20DB-$20F9 by exactly +16; the reader image changes by exactly one byte, the cmp #MAX_LEVEL_SECTORS+1 operand (45 -> 33). Every resident gameplay image - MAIN CODE/RODATA, STARFIELD, BROADSIDE, ENTITY_CODE, PICKUP_CODE, the A2 kernel and every Director image - is byte-identical to the 82c155b build. gameplay_init stays at frame 3060 on ATR against 3053 on XEX, the level image at $A600 still compares byte-exact against build/level-1.bin, and command frames stay XEX 0 / ATR 2 with 0 retries. The real transport cost of the window record is paid when the Light kernel moves into it, and the baseline is re-recorded again then.
